builds_on: LOCK 3 people (Umm Salim, Faris, Yusuf), LOCK 18 calendar (zakat year = 354 days from arrival), LOCK 8 private record. Placeholders: {c}, {t}, {n}.

panel.title: Zakat
panel.due: A lunar year has passed since you came to Ilmara. You held {c} coins, which reaches the threshold of {t}. One fortieth is due: {n} coins. It was never yours to keep.
panel.none: A lunar year has passed since you came to Ilmara. You held {c} coins, less than the threshold of {t}. No zakat is due this year.
panel.not_enough: You do not have {n} coins with you now.

options.label: Give it through Idris for the poor
options.out: Idris writes nothing down. “It will reach the poor of River Market before Friday.”

options.label: Give it to Umm Salim, the widow
options.out: Umm Salim cannot speak. She presses your hand to her forehead and goes inside.

options.label: Give it to Faris, the orphan from the quay
options.out: Faris stares at the coins, then runs off towards the cobbler's.

options.label: Give it to Yusuf, in debt to the healer
options.out: Yusuf pays the healer that same afternoon. His son Ali is well again.
